messages:
anya: Hey team, first week and I just created my first feature branch. Quick sanity: branch naming, commit messages, and who to ping for reviews?
samir: Congrats! Branch pattern we use: feat/<JIRA>-short-desc or fix/<JIRA>-short-desc. Keep it <= 50 chars, lowercase, hyphens.
meera: Commits follow Conventional Commits. Example: `feat(auth): support refresh token` or `fix(cli): handle ctrl-c`. We usually squash but make logical commits.
anya: How strict is reviewers list? My change touches runtime config + docs.
meera: Follow CODEOWNERS. For runtime config add @eng-runtime. Docs -> @docs. If cross-team, add @eng-platform. If unsure, tag @kevin.
kevin: Add two reviewers for any behavioral change that affects boot or rollout. One can be from owning team + one senior. Tiny docs/typo = one is fine.
samir: PR body template we expect: summary, issue link, how to test (steps), migration notes, checklist. Our bot enforces the checklist.
anya: Any local commands to run before pushing so CI isn't a pain?
meera: Run `./dev-setup.sh && make lint && make test-fast`. For js packages: `yarn lint:ci`. If tests are slow, run `make test-unit` first.
anya: CI flagged an eslint unused var in generated fixture. Best fix?
meera: If generated, update the generator or add `/* eslint-disable no-unused-vars */` with a comment. Prefer fixing generator for long-term.
devx-bot: Autolabeler will tag PRs by touched paths. Use Draft status for WIP. Comment `@devx-bot rerun` to requeue checks (maintainers only). :robot_face:
kevin: One more: split big refactors into an ADR/RFC or smaller incremental PRs. Reviewers will appreciate tiny diffs.
anya: I'll open as Draft and ping for a quick pair review before formal reviews. Thanks! :pray:
meera: Happy to pair-review, DM me and we can screen-share for 15 mins.
